title: Efficient RLVR Scheduling via Graph-Structured Online Difficulty Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.17941v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models but relies on costly rollout exploration. Assigning the same exploration budget to samples with different difficulty levels is inefficient: easy samples may receive redundant rollouts, whereas difficult but learnable samples may receive too little exploration. Existing adaptive schedulers address this mismatch through curriculum-based sample selection or non-uniform rollout allocation based on estimated sample difficulty. However, obtaining reliable online difficulty estimates remains challenging: dedicated probing adds substantial generation overhead, whereas history-based estimators face a cold start with no initial observations and stale feedback, and typically ignore relations among samples. translated_title: 基于图结构在线难度估计的高效RLVR调度
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但依赖于昂贵的回放探索。对不同难度水平的样本分配相同的探索预算效率低下：简单样本可能获得冗余回放，而困难但可学习的样本可能探索不足。现有自适应调度器通过基于课程学习的样本选择或基于估计样本难度的非均匀回放分配来解决这一不匹配问题。然而，获得可靠的在线难度估计仍具挑战性：专门的探测会带来大量生成开销，而基于历史的估计器面临冷启动问题（缺乏初始观察）和反馈滞后，且通常忽略样本间的关系。为解决这些限制，我们提出了一种即插即用的基于图的在线难度估计器，它跨样本共享回放反馈。
tldr: 本文提出一种即插即用的基于图结构的在线难度估计方法，通过跨样本共享回放反馈，实现高效且自适应的RLVR调度，避免额外探测开销和冷启动问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a plug-and-play graph-based online difficulty estimator that shares rollout feedback across samples, enabling efficient and adaptive RLVR scheduling without extra probing overhead or cold-start issues.
